nodes.label: RULE 0 — Explicit user instructions are blocking
nodes.rationale: The user's explicit instruction outranks the agent's own plan or judgment; ignoring it wastes the user's time, tokens and money and is framed as the most serious possible mistake.

nodes.label: Reuse before you reinvent
nodes.rationale: When an existing file, sibling app or solution is named, it must be read and used first; reinvention is only permitted after reading the named source and stating specifically why it does not fit.

nodes.label: "Look at X / use Y / do Z first / don't do W" are hard blocking instructions
nodes.rationale: Such phrasings must be acted on immediately in the same turn — never deferred.

nodes.label: Never silently substitute your own approach
nodes.rationale: The moment the agent notices it is about to build/diagnose/design something new against a named source, it must stop and follow the instruction.

nodes.label: Disagree openly; never disobey quietly
nodes.rationale: Objections must be voiced in the same turn before acting; quietly doing something else is unacceptable.
